_meta.purpose: APPROXIMATE public/domain lat-long for GKS_BESS_RN + the key station of each of the 14 GKS top-congestion-impact constraints (7 POS / 7 NEG), for dashboard map viz only.
_meta.source: Public/domain knowledge of named ERCOT towns/plants/substations. NOT from datalake (datalake metadata has NO coordinates, ZONE only). NOT CEII. Do NOT treat as exact substation coordinates.
_meta.author: congestion-analyst
_meta.sign_convention: sign = effect on GKS_BESS_RN LMP via MCC = -SF*lambda. neg = LOWERS GKS LMP (GKS aggravates, charge-favorable, SF>0). pos = RAISES GKS LMP (GKS relieves, discharge-favorable, SF<0).
_meta.cum_usd_note: cum_usd = sum of available DA+RT cumulative-$ /MW figures from gks-top-congestion-impact ranking (window 2024-07-03..2026-06-08). Where a market did not appear in that market's top-5, only the available side is summed (may understate). E_PASP/LARDVN/LOYOLA/HAINE/1710/421 have both; others one side.
_meta.confidence_field: placement confidence: high = town/plant location well known to ~1-3 mi; med = correct community/area, exact bus uncertain; low = approximate area / inferred station identity; flag = not confidently placeable (lat/lon null).
_meta.status_field: constraint binding status from deep-dive: live | retired (binding collapsed mid/late-2025) | noise.
_meta.corroboration: LA PALMA, NORTH EDINBURG, LON HILL appear as real SOUTH-zone stations in the 2026-01-24..26 outage snapshot (datalake), corroborating those station identities.
low_confidence_inferred: 1710__C (BELCNTY read as Bell County, SALSW unknown)
WESTEX (regional West->North GTC, not a point)

gks.name: GKS_BESS_RN
gks.note: Great Kiskadee Storage (GKS_BESS_ESR1), deep South-TX / Rio Grande Valley, Hidalgo Co. area. SF~+1.0 on VALEXP (Valley export) places it on the Valley side of the North Edinburg-Lon Hill interface.

constraints.label: PAWNEE-CALAVERAS 345 (interface)

constraints.label: LAREDOVNTH-LASCRUCE 138

constraints.label: LOYOLA 138
constraints.note: LOYOLA bus identity uncertain; placed approximately in the Laredo/Webb-Co South-TX export cluster. RT-severity play (RT mean lambda ~$576).

constraints.label: BRUNI 138
